root_cause: The 043 backend returned PairRequestFilterError::Policy before calling bt_create_bond because it incorrectly required the 036-style immutable 16-word core_bt_callback_table. The first correction recovered the right stock globals and 17-word descriptor but misclassified adapter+120 as a client with a descriptor field at +72; that follow-up layout was refuted by FAIL-BT-1043-BOND-1113-002 and EVID-BT-1043-PAIR-FILTER-003.
wrong_assumptions: The 036 global callback-table ABI transfers unchanged to 043.
043 core_bt_adapter_instance at 0x2013DBE4 and core_bt_registration_handle at 0x2013DBE0 are the stock companion Pair Request client state.
A missing old-style callback-table global should be represented only by a fail-closed module stub, even when exact client-owned callback state is recoverable.

negative_matches.reason: 043 address is the miwear cpevent adapter, not the stock bts companion client; use stock_bt_adapter_instance at 0x20126738 for pair-filter ownership.
043 address is the miwear cpevent handle, not the stock bts callback registration; use stock_bt_registration_handle at 0x20126734.
036-style immutable 16-word callback global has no exact 043 owner/writer and must remain withdrawn.

required_checks: Do not promote a candidate that is vetoed by negative_matches even if its ensemble score is high.
For callback-table roles, require an exact writer/reader lifecycle and descriptor word count before generating a raw binding.
Keep module-internal error-code provenance separate from firmware return values; -1107 here is a policy gate, not bt_create_bond's return.
